newsitem.title: UK: UK's FTSE 100 opens higher despite Wall St nerves.
newsitem.headline: UK's FTSE 100 opens higher despite Wall St nerves.

text.p: The UK's FTSE 100 index pushed higher on Thursday despite a volatile performance by U.S. stocks and lingering fears that interest rates had not yet peaked.
Investors showed relief that Wall Street had finished just 33 points lower on Wednesday after dropping by as much as 75 points during the session.
"Wall Street could have beeen a lot worse," said one trader. "It was all over the place during the session. But it will create nervousness again as we approach the opening today."
The FTSE 100 index was up 28 points at 5,031.6 after fifteen minutes trade. Gainers were in a 85:8 majority.
